label: Bible Study
prompt: Let us search and try our _____, and turn again to the LORD.
verse: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
note: In the middle of the lament, a call to self-examination — then turning back home.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the _____ is too great for thee.
verse: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
note: An angel feeds worn-out Elijah a second time: arise and eat, for the journey is too great for thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a _____.
verse: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
note: Jeremiah's excuse when God called: 'I am a child' — God's answer was, don't say that, just go.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verse: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
note: The one debt Paul says you can never pay off — love one another, and the law is fulfilled.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, _____, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verse: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
note: Paul's prayer list for Timothy: 'supplications, prayers, intercessions,' and thanks — for all men, kings included.
